row.reason: Both are in energy fuels. Par Pacific refines crude into fuels and sells them wholesale and at retail. Suburban Propane buys propane and other fuels and delivers them to homes and businesses. The two overlap on commercial and industrial fuel supply. They differ on product (refined transport fuels vs propane for heating) and on model (refiner vs retail distributor with HVAC services). That makes them adjacent, not direct.
